strings.name: Luka Dončić
strings.role: Basketball guard · Lakers and Slovenia international
strings.summary: Dončić rose through Real Madrid's academy to become a EuroLeague champion and MVP, then an NBA offensive fulcrum through pace control, scoring and creative passing. He helped Slovenia win EuroBasket 2017, led Dallas to the 2024 NBA Finals and was traded to the Lakers in 2025. A second NBA scoring title in 2026 illustrates his role in European basketball's international development.
